Title: Reliaburger 0.2.0 online workshop
Description:
Want to spend an hour breaking a cluster?

Reliaburger is an open-source container orchestrator in a single binary: one agent per node, one CLI, and no control plane to assemble. Scheduling, ingress, service discovery, secrets, a registry, metrics, logs and fault injection are all built in. It runs your existing Kubernetes manifests. https://reliaburger.com/

Together, step by step, we'll:

- set up a small cluster on your own laptop
- launch a real web app and open it in your browser
- slow it down and switch parts of it off on purpose
- watch it notice the problem and fix itself

Bring: a Mac, or Linux with QEMU/KVM, plus ~8 GB free RAM and 15 GB of disk.

See you there!
